social.selection_rule: Minimum development ADE, tie smaller parameter count

independent.selection_rule: Minimum development ADE, tie smaller parameter count

static.selection_rule: Minimum development ADE, tie smaller parameter count

short_history.selection_rule: Minimum development ADE, tie smaller parameter count

probabilistic.selection_rule: Minimum development ADE, tie smaller parameter count

config.independent_rule: Independent baseline also serves as no-social ablation: match selected social width, layer count, learning rate and three seeds; select its stopping epoch on development only.
config.evaluation_rule: Select solely on 132877; refit all seven for selected best epoch; held-out evaluation once per final seed.
config.history_rule: 51 observed time points over 2 s; short history 11 points; no interpolation; segment break on gaps/track changes/jumps.
config.constant_velocity_rule: Least squares over last 11 actual samples, require 6 samples, cap 12 m/s; no future data.
config.uncertainty_rule: Optional isotropic Gaussian, temperature calibrated only on development; held-out radial coverage at 50/80/95 percent.
config.pass_subset_rule: BAS Pass within +/-25 frames of anchor; all observed players evaluated; BAS never model input.

progress.input_protection: Only raw GSR and BAS evaluation subsets are read. No writes to data/ or existing results/review material.
